scope: Four named natal structural candidates inspired by selected primary-text branches; not four complete traditional mortality systems
direction: higher score hypothesized to accompany more deaths after age 20 and before age 60
input_contract: R6 strict anonymous birth-only whitelist; unknown precision remains unknown

BZ01.label: 子平阳刃重复而无官杀制伏：出生结构子模型
BZ01.source: 三命通会卷六，论阳刃；五阳干有刃、重复与制伏分支
BZ01.control_definition: Any natal exposed stem or any hidden stem in the four branches with the element that controls the day stem; either polarity counts as officer/killing
BZ01.formula: 1 iff day stem is in yang_blade_branch AND count of its blade branch in the four natal branches >=2 AND no control stem; else 0
researcher_choices: repeated means at least two of four branches
any listed exposed or hidden controller suppresses the flag regardless of strength
omitted_conditions: other rescue gods and competing structures
BZ01.not_a_claim: Not the unconditional proposition that a blade, repeated blades, or lack of this flag determines death

ZW01.label: 紫微七杀临身与指定救应：出生结构子模型
ZW01.source: 紫微斗数全书卷三，诸星同垣七杀条与论七杀重逢的指定救应
ZW01.formula: 0 if no 七杀 in body palace; 1 if 七杀 there and any designated rescue star in body-palace three-directions/four-rectifications; 2 if 七杀 there without this rescue
researcher_choices: extend the named rescue rule to the natal body-palace branch
meeting means body palace plus offsets 4,6,8
0/1/2 ordinal order is a fixed research score
ZW01.not_a_claim: Not the complete Ziwei longevity method or a numerical interpretation of ten-live-nine-die

QZP01.label: 七政昼夜日月受克黄经代理；非完整七政四余
QZP01.source: 张果星宗四，天纲日度昼生火罗/月度夜生土计条件中的七政部分
QZP01.day_definition: unrefracted geocentric solar-center altitude at the supplied location >=0 degrees; exact zero belongs to day
QZP01.formula: 1 iff selected day/night pair has circular ecliptic longitude separation <=5 degrees; else 0
researcher_choices: luminary proxy replaces the original sun/moon mansion-ruler prerequisite
5 modern longitude degrees is a declared research tolerance, not a supplied classical orb
uses geocentric tropical positions for reproducibility
omitted_conditions: Rahu/Ketu portions of the cited condition
QZP01.not_a_claim: Only a seven-planet positional proxy; does not count as an executed full Qizheng-Siyu model

W01.label: 托勒密土火日月相位及木金射线救应：本命位置子模型
W01.source: Ptolemy Tetrabiblos III.10 destructive and preserving places; applied here only as a fixed natal structural proxy
W01.formula: For each of 2 luminaries x 2 malefics count 1 when a listed malefic ray is within 5 degrees; ignore a malefic within 15 degrees of Sun; bodily conjunction also requires latitude difference <=1 degree; remove that pair if an eligible Jupiter/Venus ray is at the malefic ray or follows it by <=12/8 degrees. Sum 0..4.
researcher_choices: use both natal luminaries instead of full prorogator selection
replace directed encounter by natal proximity
5-degree malefic orb and 1-degree bodily latitude tolerance are research values
15-degree solar-ray exclusion is a frozen research simplification
each luminary-malefic pair has equal unit weight
omitted_conditions: complete prorogator and previous syzygy selection
primary directions and equinoctial period/year conversion
W01.not_a_claim: Not Tetrabiblos III.10 reconstructed in full; score 0..4 is not a death probability

ensemble.formula: arithmetic mean of the four normalized scores only when all four are available
ensemble.missing_component_policy: abstain; do not renormalize remaining systems

perturbation_policy.clock_shift: shift local Gregorian-converted civil timestamp and nominal UTC/UT1 instant by the same amount; preserve source offset, location, sex and every other permitted input field; reserialize to the original calendar
perturbation_policy.timezone_id_policy: retain zone ID; if shifted instant conflicts with unchanged source offset across a DST boundary the ordinary input gate rejects, never silently repairs

quality_gates.bazi: R6 four-pillar implementation and solar-term gates passed
quality_gates.ziwei: R6 pinned engine status computed_for_declared_convention and exactly one body palace
quality_gates.planetary: R6 Swiss/Astronomy Engine cross-engine angle gate passed
quality_gates.missing_coordinates: QZP01 abstains; W01 planetary score still computes
quality_gates.unknown_birth_precision: retain limitation; point scores do not certify actual birth precision

analysis_contract: Root fixes AA primary, A sensitivity, endpoint, eligibility, multiplicity and test procedure without using these scores or held-out outcomes. No rule, orb, direction or weight can change in response to the real input/output.
